Name: Grown kids
Author: K1riko87
Description:
[i][size=4][color=#b6d7a8][font=serif]Chinese and English versions available, feel free to download.[/font][/color][/size][/i]

[i][size=4][font=serif][color=#00ffff][b]如果大家有任何建议或者期待的功能，随时欢迎提出！  Suggestions and feedback are always welcome.[/b][/color] [/font][/size][/i]

[size=5][b]ALT+F6可以快速调整孩子的年龄与好感[/b]
[b]ALT+F6 can quickly adjust the child's age and favorability. [/b][/size]

孩子到达原版最后一个幼儿阶段后，再过[color=#9900ff]14个游戏日就会长大[/color]。如果存档里的孩子已经超过这个时间，安装模组后可能会直接成长。
长大后，孩子仍会保留原来的姓名、亲子关系和好感度，肤色与帽子也会继承下来。对话头像和社交页面会换成成年后的样子，但他们不会占用多人游戏的玩家位置。
每天[color=#9900ff]和孩子交谈，可以聊天、赠送食物、查看工作进度，或者安排当天的工作[/color]。
[list]
[*][color=#9900ff][size=4]0到3颗心：聊天、送食物或休息。[/size][/color][/*]
[*][color=#9900ff][size=4]4到7颗心：可以选择浇水、收获或照看机器。[/size][/color][/*]
[*][color=#9900ff][size=4]8到10颗心：可以同时负责全部工作。[/size][/color][/*]
[/list][color=#9900ff][size=4]玩家可以与孩子交互获取工作箱，每个存档只会有一个工作箱，如若丢失，需要找马龙购买。[/size][/color]

每天第一次聊天增加20点好感。[color=#9900ff]每天可以赠送一次水果、蔬菜或其他可食用物品，增加45点好感。[/color]当天再次送礼不会消耗物品。让孩子工作不会降低好感度。
孩子[color=#9900ff]可以为农场和温室里的作物浇水，也能处理花盆中的作物。[/color]他们会跳过已经浇水、被雨水浇湿、枯死或不需要浇水的作物。
收获工作包括普通作物、花盆作物、果树，以及原版中需要镰刀收割的作物。[color=#9900ff]孩子不会播种、施肥，也不会采集巨大作物、浆果丛和野外采集物。[/color]
[color=#9900ff]机器工作目前支持：[/color]
[list]
[*][color=#9900ff]酒桶[/color][/*]
[*][color=#9900ff]罐头瓶[/color][/*]
[*][color=#9900ff]熏鱼机[/color][/*]
[*][color=#9900ff]熔炉[/color][/*]
[/list]孩子会收走已经完成的产品，再从工作箱中取出下一轮需要的材料。咖啡豆、煤炭和矿石等材料仍按原版配方消耗，物品不会从玩家背包里拿取。
每个存档可以免费领取一个共享工作箱。工作箱共有五个分类页面和175个格子，分别存放四类机器的原料与成品，以及孩子收获的农产品。多个孩子可以共用同一个工作箱，也不会重复处理同一台机器。
孩子会亲自走到作物、机器和工作箱旁边完成工作。如果道路被堵住、材料不足或箱子没有空间，他们会暂时等待，条件恢复后再继续。已经拿在身上的物品会保留下来，不会因为中断工作而消失。
每天晚上8:30以后，孩子不会再开始新的工作。晚上9:00回家，10:00上床睡觉。你也可以随时暂停当前任务，让孩子回到家门口等待，然后重新安排工作。想让他们休息一天也可以。
工作箱必须放在农场、温室或农场建筑里。请保留儿童床，并给工作箱、机器、门口和床铺留出能够通行的道路。
目前主要按单人游戏进行测试。多人游戏通信已经加入，但还没有完成多客户端环境下的完整验证。
需要 Stardew Valley 1.6 和 SMAPI 4.x。
[heading]Full description[/heading]
English
Children grow up 14 in-game days after reaching the final vanilla toddler stage. If a child in an existing save is already old enough, they may grow up as soon as the mod is installed.
Their name, family relationship, friendship, skin tone, and hat are kept. Their portrait and Social tab icon change to match their grown appearance, but they do not take up a multiplayer player slot.
[color=#9900ff]Talk to a grown child to chat, offer food, check their progress, or choose their job for the day.[/color]
[list]
[*][color=#9900ff]At 0 to 3 hearts, they can chat, accept food, or take the day off.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#9900ff]At 4 to 7 hearts, you can assign watering, harvesting, or machine tending.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#9900ff]At 8 to 10 hearts, they can handle all three jobs together.[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#9900ff][size=4]Players can interact with their children to obtain a workbox. There is only one workbox per save file. If it is lost, you will need to purchase one from Marlon.[/size] [/color]

The first chat each day gives 20 friendship points. [color=#9900ff]One edible fruit, vegetable, or food gift gives 45 points. Extra gifts on the same day are not consumed. Sending a child to work does not lower friendship.[/color]
Watering covers crops on the farm and in the Greenhouse, including Garden Pots. Crops that are already watered, watered by rain, dead, or do not need water are skipped.
Harvesting covers regular crops, Garden Pot crops, fruit trees, and vanilla crops normally collected with a scythe. [color=#9900ff]Children do not plant seeds, use fertilizer, harvest giant crops, shake berry bushes, or gather wild forage.[/color]
[color=#9900ff]Machine tending currently supports:[/color]
[list]
[*][color=#9900ff]Kegs[/color][/*]
[*][color=#9900ff]Preserves Jars[/color][/*]
[*][color=#9900ff]Fish Smokers[/color][/*]
[*][color=#9900ff]Furnaces[/color][/*]
[/list]Children collect finished products and load the next batch using supplies from the Work Chest. Vanilla recipes still apply, including Coffee Bean quantities and Coal requirements. They never take supplies from the player's inventory.
Each save receives one free shared Work Chest. It has five pages and 175 slots for machine supplies, finished products, and harvested goods. Multiple children can use the same chest without trying to service the same machine.
Work is carried out in the world rather than completed instantly. Children walk to crops, machines, and the chest, carry items between them, and play short work animations. If a path is blocked, supplies run out, or the chest is full, they wait and try again later. Anything they are already carrying remains safe.
Children stop starting new work at 8:30 PM, head home at 9:00 PM, and go to bed at 10:00 PM. You can pause an assignment at any time, have them wait by the front door, and then choose a different job. You can also give them the day off.
The Work Chest must be placed on the farm, in the Greenhouse, or inside a farm building. Keep the Child Beds and walking routes to machines, chests, doors, and beds clear.
The mod is primarily tested in single-player. Multiplayer messaging is included, but full testing with multiple connected players has not been completed.
Requires Stardew Valley 1.6 and SMAPI 4.x.
